primary.title: Sebi panel weighs proposal to open physically settled commodity trades to FPIs
primary.summary: The proposal seeks to address a long-standing tax hurdle that has kept FPIs out of bullion and base metal derivatives, where contracts are compulsorily deliverable on expiry.
